{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Monthly construction cost indices and building permit issuances across regional markets by the National Statistics Bureau, 2022–2024

The National Statistics Bureau compiled monthly construction producer price indices, component input costs, and municipal building permit authorizations from January 2022 to June 2024. The data was collected under the national economic surveillance framework to evaluate cost push pressures, tracking how escalating material prices versus rising unionized labour rates affect residential and commercial building activity across macro-regions.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `building_type` | category | Single-Family Houses, Multi-Family Apartments, Commercial & Retail, Industrial & Logistics; within sector; group sector_hierarchy |
| `cost_growth_gap` | measure | unit percentage points; non-additive |
| `country_zone` | category | North & East, South & West; group geography |
| `material_cost_index` | measure | unit index (2021=100); non-additive |
| `permits_issued` | measure | unit permits; additive |
| `quarter` | category | 2022-Q1, 2022-Q2, 2022-Q3, 2022-Q4, 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4, 2024-Q1, 2024-Q2; ordered=ordinal; derived from report_month; group calendar |
| `region` | category | Northern Metro, Eastern Industrial, Southern Coastal, Western Uplands; within country_zone; group geography |
| `report_month` | time | 2022-01-01 to 2024-06-01, monthly; group calendar |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: line, grouped by report_month, AVG(material_cost_index), unit index (2021=100)
    p0 reads report_month off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How did material and labour cost indices evolve over the two and a half year surveillance period
- `f02`
    p0: bar, grouped by building_type, AVG(cost_growth_gap), unit percentage points
    p0 reads building_type off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which building types face the highest labour to material cost growth gap
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(material_cost_index, permits_issued), unit index (2021=100), permits
    drawn to answer: How does the volume of permits issued correlate with rising material cost indices
- `f04`

    p0 reads region off the axis tick

    p1 is titled '2023-03-19 to 2024-06-01'

    p0 reads building_type off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric
